title: India and Japan Launch Operational Manual for the Joint Crediting Mechanism
body_text:
On 30th September, 2026, Ambassador of Japan to India, H.E. Mr. Keiichi Ono and the then Secretary (MoEFCC), Shri Tanmay Kumar, jointly launched the Operational Manual for the India–Japan Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM) , in New Delhi.
The Joint Crediting Mechanism between India and Japan aims to promote the deployment of advanced low-carbon technologies, mobilize climate finance, facilitate technology cooperation and support high-integrity emission reductions and removals in India. The mechanism will contribute to sustainable development in India while strengthening confidence and transparency in international carbon markets.
The launch of the Manual marks a significant milestone in operationalizing bilateral cooperation between India and Japan under Article 6.2 of the Paris Agreement, following the signing of Memorandum of Cooperation (MoC) on 7 th August 2025 and adoption of the Rule of Implementation (RoI) on 8 th June 2026.
The development signals a transition from institutional preparation to implementation and establishes a clear, transparent and comprehensive procedural framework for implementing activities under India-Japan JCM. The manual provides detailed procedures covering the entire project cycle—from the submission of a Project Idea Note to the issuance and authorization of JCM credits.
